snippet.title: TERPENIE // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028600/TERPENIE

In the gloomy atmosphere of post-Soviet everyday life, routine tasks like cleaning, cooking, and exploring your own room hide something much darker. Survive and uncover the truth before the maniac comes for you.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Chugunovkos aka @chugunovkos7136 
📚 Publisher: Chugunovkos
📅 Release Date: Oct 17, 2025
🎯 Genre: Indie, Free To Play

Mature Content Description
The developers describe the content like this:
The game contains elements of psychological horror, surveillance, and disturbing scenes. The atmosphere is dark and may cause discomfort for some players.
